{{DISPLAYTITLE:''Wandering Witch'' (Anime)}} {{Anime |name = Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina |image = Anime Key Visual.png |director = [[wikipedia:Toshiyuki Kubooka|Toshiyuki Kubooka]] |series_comp = Kazuyuki Fudeyasu |char_design = Takeshi Oda |music = AstroNoteS |studio = [[wikipedia:C2C (studio)|C2C]] |original_run = October 2nd, 2020 – December 18th, 2020 |episodes = 12 }} '''''Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina''''' (魔女の旅々, ''Majo no Tabitabi'', lit. "''A Witch's Journey''") is an anime adaptation of the {{WW|Japanese light novel series of the same name}}, written by [[Jōgi Shiraishi]] and illustrated by Azure. It premiered on October 2nd, 2020 and ran for 12 episodes to December 18th, 2020. On September 24th, 2025, the official website announced the a rebroadcast on [[w:c:animanga:Tokyo MX|Tokyo MX]] starting late night on October 9th, 2025 and the revival of the radio show "The Radio of Elaina" for a public recording on October 4th, 2025 hosted by seiyuu [[w:c:seiyuu:Hondo Kaede|Kaede Hondo]].''TV anime "Wandering Witch: The Journey of Elaina" official website'' (TVアニメ『魔女の旅々』公式サイト) - [https://majotabi.jp/news.html#news-250924-3 NEWS 【アニメ5周年】『魔女のラジ々』公開録音イベントが開催決定] (in Japanese; in English: ''[5th Anniversary of the Anime] Public recording event for "Witch's Radio" to be held'') 2025.9.24 On January 4, 2026, a [[Wandering Witch (Movie)|new movie]] has been announced. == Synopsis == Inspired by her favorite book, Elaina ventures out to see the world she's read so much about. Like a leaf on the wind, she travels from one country to another, looking to sate her inquisitiveness and searching for new experiences. She's confronted by humanity in all its forms, whether strange, bizarre, or emotional. Exploration and curiosity drive her journey. Where to next, Elaina?[https://www.funimation.com/shows/wandering-witch-the-journey-of-elaina/ Funimation] == Cast == *[[w:c:seiyuu:Hondo Kaede|Kaede Hondo]] as [[Elaina]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Hanazawa Kana|Kana Hanazawa]] as [[Fran]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Kurosawa Tomoyo|Tomoyo Kurosawa]] as [[Saya]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Hikasa Yoko|Yōko Hikasa]] as [[Sheila]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Ito Shizuka|Shizuka Itō]] as [[Victorica]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Konomi Kohara|Konomi Kohara]] as [[Amnesia]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Tatsumi Yuiko|Yuiko Tatsumi]] as [[Artemisia]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Kawanishi Kengo|Kengo Kawanishi]] as [[Chara]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Saito Kimiko|Kimiko Saitō]] as Curio Company Boss *[[w:c:seiyuu:Ueda Reina|Reina Ueda]] as [[Ripper]] (Doll Shop Owner) *[[w:c:seiyuu:Sato Rina|Rina Satō]] as [[Eihemia]] *[[w:c:seiyuu:Uchiyama Yumi|Yumi Uchiyama]] as [[Estelle]] == Music == === Opening Theme === * [[Literature]] (リテラチュア) by [[wikipedia:Reina Ueda|Reina Ueda]] === Ending Theme === * [[Haiiro no Saga]] (灰色のサーガ) by [[wikipedia:ChouCho|ChouCho]] == Episodes == {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" ! width="2%" |# ! width="45%" |Episode Name ! width="18%" |JP Air Date ! width="18%" |EN Air Date |- |1 |[[Episode 1|'''Elaina, the Apprentice Witch''']]
